- Order rows by `rowid` (insertion order, which matches chronological order).  
- Select the last 3 rows (ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 3).  
- Extract Alabama’s score from each `Result` string (substring after the first two characters, up to the en dash '–').  
- Sum the scores as integers.

```sql
SELECT SUM(CAST(SUBSTR(Result, 3, INSTR(Result, '–') - 3) AS INTEGER)) AS total_points
FROM (
    SELECT Result FROM my_table ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 3
);
```
